outcome.answer: The provided results do not include any paper explicitly titled “Yang GraDE frequent subgraph discovery,” but they do include a GraDE paper by Yikang Yang et al.: “GraDE: A Graph Diffusion Estimator for Frequent Subgraph Discovery in Neural Architectures” [1]. GraDE proposes a diffusion-guided search framework with a Graph Diffusion Estimator that scores how “typical” candidate subgraphs are within a learned distribution to improve frequent subgraph discovery beyond what enumeration or sampling alone can achieve [1].
